en: A multi-image color postcard showing three views of a Gothic cathedral complex above a historic town. The left image is a close frontal view of a dark stone twin‑towered Gothic church with very tall spires, flanked by lighter historic buildings and a tree‑lined square. The top‑right and bottom‑right images show the same cathedral and attached castle-like buildings on a hill above a river and red‑tiled roofs; in the bottom view a river steamer is visible on the water. No printed text is visible on the front.
